correctness.rationale: Affine reduction is exact and the frequency fibers have size \(5^{d-2}\). Factorable bilinear polynomials have exactly \(0,5,9\) local zeros. Nonfactorable ones have at most one zero per row, and five zeros would induce a Möbius permutation of the regular pentagon; the only such permutations are dihedral, and their two rational forms contradict four nonzero coefficients. Exact cyclotomic witnesses realize each remaining zero count \(1,2,3,4\). The bundled verifier checks the witness zero sets and the complete finite Möbius-permutation lemma without floating point.
